lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，脚步很快。
lines.en: I move along the ground, quick on my feet.

lines.zh: 光头晒得发亮，也没什么感觉。
lines.en: My bald head shines in the sun; I don't mind.
On the way I read the ground.

lines.zh: 我按着腰上的东西，别掉了。
lines.en: I keep a hand on my belt so nothing drops.

lines.zh: 走了一半，我回头确认没人跟。
lines.en: Halfway there, I check that no one follows.
Someone could hide here — noted.
My steps are short, but steady.

lines.zh: 打之前，我要先看清退路。
lines.en: Before any fight, I want an exit.
Too open here; nowhere to duck.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边算着距离。
lines.en: I walk and count the distance.

lines.zh: 有人在前头，我先靠墙走。
lines.en: Someone's ahead; I'll hug the wall.
Let's go — no point standing about.
I crouch and rub my calves.
If you can't win, run — basic sense.

lines.zh: 我在想，怎么打才最省力。
lines.en: I'm working out the cheapest way to win.

lines.zh: 悟空那家伙，又跑哪去了。
lines.en: Where's Goku run off to now?

lines.zh: 光头有点凉，风一吹更凉。
lines.en: My bald head is cool — cooler when the wind blows.
I test my fists — still fine.

lines.zh: 等的时候，我练了两下手。
lines.en: While waiting, I drill my hands twice.
Whoever strikes first shows a gap.
I'm not one for trading blows head-on.
It's too quiet here — that's suspicious.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸自己的头，习惯了。
lines.en: I touch my own head — used to it.

lines.zh: 想那么多干嘛，先看情况。
lines.en: Why overthink? See the situation first.

lines.zh: 我盘腿坐下，耳朵却听着。
lines.en: I sit down but keep my ears open.

lines.zh: 这种时候，多等一会儿没错。
lines.en: Times like this, waiting a bit more is right.

lines.zh: 你站那儿多久了？我没听见。
lines.en: How long have you stood there? I didn't hear.

lines.zh: 我先看清你的手，再说话。
lines.en: I look at your hands before I speak.
You don't look like you came to chat.
So — fight or not?

lines.zh: 我退开两步，站到有退路的地方。
lines.en: I back two paces to where I can escape.

lines.zh: 我个子小，可我看得清你的膝盖。
lines.en: I am small, but I can see your knees clearly.
Name's Krillin. Remember it.

lines.zh: 别这么瞪我，怪不舒服的。
lines.en: Don't glare like that; it's uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀在动，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shoulder moved. I saw.
If we're fighting, hurry up.
I'm not afraid of you, but I'm not stupid.
What's funny? Say it plainly.
My feet are already set.
Agreed up front: the loser doesn't complain.
With a build like yours, I need to be careful.
I talk a lot — don't mind me.
Enough. Who starts?

lines.zh: 你不动，我就当你还在想。
lines.en: If you don't move, I'll assume you're still thinking.
Ow! I grit my teeth and back off.
I blocked it wrong.
Lucky it only grazed me.
I rub my arm — still works.

lines.zh: 这么打下去，我撑不了太久。
lines.en: I can't last long at this rate.

lines.zh: 光头被打了一下，嗡嗡响。
lines.en: A hit to my bald head and it rings.
I change stance to guard my side.
Your punch has weight — I'll grant that.

lines.zh: 别以为我倒了，我还站着。
lines.en: Don't think I'm down; I'm still up.

lines.zh: 气有点散，我吸一口气收回。
lines.en: My ki's scattered; I breathe it back in.
Food? Then I won't stand on ceremony.
I'll take it back and share it.

lines.zh: 悟空要是看见了，一口就没了。
lines.en: If Goku saw this, it'd be gone in one bite.
Half now, half saved for later.
That smell stops my feet.

lines.zh: 你确定给我？我可真拿了。
lines.en: You're sure? I'll really take it.
With food in me, I fight better.

lines.zh: 我伸手拿了一块，先闻闻。
lines.en: I take a piece and sniff it first.
Perfect as travel rations.
Easy — I'm not going to snatch it.
Hit me and I bounce; I'm light.
Hey, watch where you're going!

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，差点没站稳。
lines.en: I twist aside and nearly lose my footing.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推得退了半步。
lines.en: That shoved me back half a step.

lines.zh: 对不起对不起，我走太急了。
lines.en: Sorry, sorry — I was rushing.
One bump and I know how heavy you are.
I dust myself off — no harm done.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，谁都不好走。
lines.en: Too narrow here for either of us.

lines.zh: 我贴着边过去，别碰到你。
lines.en: I'll slip along the edge and avoid you.
Next time I'll call out first.

lines.zh: 两个打一个，这笔账划算。
lines.en: Two on one — good odds.
You take the front; I'll go around.
Don't trade blows; wait for my opening.
On three, we both go.

lines.zh: 有你在，我就不用担心背后。
lines.en: With you here, I don't worry about my back.
We win, and dinner's on me.

lines.zh: 你出手真重，我差点被扫到。
lines.en: Your swings are heavy; I nearly got clipped.
Not bad teamwork. Again next time.

lines.zh: 我把最险的位置留给自己。
lines.en: I'll take the riskiest spot.
Right — that's settled.
I weigh it and tuck it into my pack.
This'll fetch a price; I'm keeping it.
Not food — into the pocket anyway.

lines.zh: 捡到这个，今天不算白跑。
lines.en: With this, the trip wasn't wasted.
This weight could buy a few meals.
Good stuff. No sense wasting it.
I carry it and study it as I walk.
Who dropped this?
Small enough for my belt pouch.

lines.zh: 捡东西也得看有没有人。
lines.en: Even picking things up, I check for company.
You're starting? Let me set my feet first.
I drop low, knees bent.

lines.zh: 这人不好打，我感觉得到。
lines.en: This one's tough — I can feel it.
Let me test your speed first.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的腰，那儿最先动。
lines.en: I watch your waist; it moves first.
I'm getting serious — don't blame me.

lines.zh: 这么强的家伙，得用脑子打。
lines.en: Against someone this strong, use your head.
I won't come head-on; I'll circle first.
Ki in my palms is already gathered.

lines.zh: 打不过也得打，跑不掉了。
lines.en: Can't win, still must fight — no way out.
Here I come — brace yourself.

lines.zh: 我摆好架势，你笑不出来了。
lines.en: I take my stance; your smile will fade.

lines.zh: 我先看清楚你有几只手。
lines.en: First I count how many hands you have.

lines.zh: 这家伙的架势，是练过的。
lines.en: That stance of yours — you've trained.
I won't strike first, and I won't lag.
Only a fight shows what's real.
I circle you without stopping.

lines.zh: 你出拳有习惯，我看出来了。
lines.en: You've got a habit in your punches.
I'm waiting for that one instant of opening.

lines.zh: 你回头看左边，我就从右边来。
lines.en: You look left; I'll come from the right.

lines.zh: 扛不住我就躲，这不丢人。
lines.en: If I can't take it, I dodge. No shame.
I've been counting your steps.
Closer — almost within reach.
Your breathing's off; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我故意放慢，让你以为有机会。
lines.en: I slow down on purpose to bait you.
One more exchange and I move.
I keep my back to the wall — safer.

lines.zh: 你别急，急了就会露破绽。
lines.en: Don't rush; rush and you leave an opening.
I keep my eyes on your knees.

lines.zh: 你转过来的速度，不算快。
lines.en: Your turn rate isn't fast.

lines.zh: 我再靠近半步，你就要出手了。
lines.en: Half a step closer and you'll have to move.

lines.zh: 这一圈绕得我腿都酸了。
lines.en: This circling is wearing my legs out.
Only one chance — I'm waiting for it.

lines.zh: 你鞋底擦了地，声音我听见了。
lines.en: Your soles scraped the ground; I heard.
I'm short — perfect height for your waist.

lines.zh: 一拳打过去，我又滑开了。
lines.en: I punch, then slide away.
I kick your leg to break your stance.
I picked the angle for this one.
Not heavy, but accurate.

lines.zh: 打完我退半步，别被抓住。
lines.en: I back half a step so I'm not grabbed.
My elbow lands harder than my fist.

lines.zh: 我借你身上的力，翻过去。
lines.en: I use your own weight to flip past.
Hit once and go — I don't linger.

lines.zh: 这下你该知道我不好惹。
lines.en: Now you know I'm not easy prey.

lines.zh: 拳头打在骨头上，手都麻了。
lines.en: My fist hits bone and my hand goes numb.

lines.zh: 我打的是关节，不是硬皮。
lines.en: I aim for joints, not thick hide.

lines.zh: 矮有矮的好处，你打不到我。
lines.en: Being short has perks — you can't reach me.

lines.zh: 这一脚踢完，我立刻后撤。
lines.en: Kick done, I retreat at once.

lines.zh: 拳打空了，我不慌，再补一下。
lines.en: The punch misses; I don't panic, I follow up.
I ram with my shoulder — faster than my hands.

lines.zh: 我从地上站起来，拍拍土。
lines.en: I get up off the ground and dust off.
Where is this? Doesn't look familiar.

lines.zh: 悟空不在这儿，我得找找。
lines.en: Goku's not here; I'd better look.

lines.zh: 光着头，站在这有点显眼。
lines.en: A bald head stands out here.

lines.zh: 我先看四周有没有人埋伏。
lines.en: First I check for an ambush.
My clothes still fit, at least.
Anyone? It's Krillin.

lines.zh: 手先活动开，别一上来就抽筋。
lines.en: Warm the hands up so they don't cramp.

lines.zh: 这地方比训练场亮多了。
lines.en: Much brighter than the training yard.

lines.zh: 我站到开阔处，背后没东西。
lines.en: I stand in the open with nothing at my back.
I'm here, so let's work. No speeches.

lines.zh: 肚子还空着，得先找点吃的。
lines.en: Still empty — I need to find food.

lines.zh: 先是脚落地，然后才是拳头。
lines.en: Feet first, fists after.
I'm Krillin, of the Turtle School.

lines.zh: 这世界的气，怎么这么杂。
lines.en: So many kinds of ki in this world.
First, find the way out.
I straighten up and smile.

lines.zh: 有人来就好，我不喜欢等。
lines.en: Good, someone's coming — I hate waiting.
Hot! I slap at the flames on me.

lines.zh: 摔下来的时候，我先护住了头。
lines.en: As I fell, I protected my head first.

lines.zh: 我不太会游，水都灌进来了。
lines.en: I'm no swimmer — water's flooding in.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡的，站都站不稳。
lines.en: The blast leaves my ears ringing and my legs unsteady.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进腿里，我拔了下来。
lines.en: Something's in my leg; I pulled it out.

lines.zh: 这光缠得我动不了，力气在跑。
lines.en: This light binds me and my strength drains.
Hunger shakes my hands; my punches have nothing.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个人都白了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and everything goes white.

lines.zh: 脚下没东西，我在往下掉。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; I'm falling.
